p3_b3.ocr: doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0148977.t004 We performed the same GO-term analysis for luminal A data that we performed in the cell line data. We chose 1,823 and 1,407 genes that were predicted with an MCC > 0.6 and MCC < 0.2, respectively. 534 of the genes with MCC > 0.6 in the TCGA data overlapped with the genes with MCC > 0.6 in the cell line data (hypergeometric p-value < 2.01 e-41). Table 6 shows only the top 30 GO terms for genes with high MCC and Table 7 shows all of the GO terms for genes with low MCC. Similar to our previous result for the cell line data, we found that genes that predicted well were again enriched in GO-terms related to the regulation of var- ious biological processes while genes that were predicted poorly were not.
